cited_source_identities.title: A Novel Approach to Eliminating Hallucinations in Large Language Model-Assisted Causal Discovery
cited_source_identities.local_path: docs/papers/A Novel Approach to Eliminating Hallucinations in Large Language Model-Assisted Causal Discovery Sng(2024).pdf

inspected_anchors.finding: Nine-variable life-expectancy case and edge-audit prompts.
Hallucination metric is contradiction across causal-rating prompts; this does not measure true-edge accuracy.
RAG supplies a mocked true causal graph; experiment isolates use of provided information.
Two debaters plus arbiter with engineered opposing positions.
Authors explicitly state that reduced hallucination does not imply accurate causal prediction; true-graph validation and more datasets are future work.
